_source: Analyst-supplied Supplier required-field list, 29-Jul-2026 (Subrato). One row per sheet + field marked * in the Oracle FBDI template.
_note: The uploaded list repeats some rows because a single FBDI sheet covers several record blocks — Supplier Bank Import carries the payee, the bank account and the account assignment. Duplicates are collapsed here; the sheet still requires every field listed under it.
_authority: Oracle FBDI template asterisks as transcribed by the analyst. Where this disagrees with a parsed template field, THIS list is what the pre-generation gate enforces, because it is the list the analyst signed off.
_open_items: Supplier Number is required on Supplier Bank Import but section 10.6 removed auto-numbering on analyst instruction, so it is blank unless mapped. Either map it from the legacy id or accept that the bank sheet cannot load until the Supplier Number strategy is settled (Raja).

Remit-to Supplier on Supplier Site Import holds Y in the current extract where a supplier NAME belongs (section 10.10). Present-but-wrong passes a not-blank check, so this needs a value rule, not just a presence rule.
_sheet_alias_note: A conversion's template names its sheets after the Oracle INTERFACE TABLE (POZ_SUPPLIERS_INT); this list names them after the analyst TAB (Supplier Import). The gate matched on the tab name alone and so recognised no sheet at all, reporting every required field absent and blocking healthy conversions. Both vocabularies are in use in the repo — fbdi_service writes POZ_SUPPLIER_ADDRESSES_INT, fusion_service writes POZ_SUP_ADDRESSES_INT — so both spellings are listed. Matching folds case and punctuation, so POZ_SUPPLIERS_INT, poz suppliers int and pozsuppliersint all resolve.
